def all_unique(lst):
    """
    Check if all elements in the given list are unique.
    
    Args:
        lst (list): The input list of elements
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if all elements are unique, False otherwise
    """
    # Convert to set and compare lengths
    return len(lst) == len(set(lst))


# Test cases
assert all_unique([1, 2, 3]) == True
print("Test passed!")

# Additional test cases for clarity:
assert all_unique([]) == True          # Empty list is unique
assert all_unique([1, 1, 2]) == False  # Duplicates exist

def all_unique(lst):
    """
    Check if all elements in the given list are unique.
    
    Args:
        lst (list): The input list of elements
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if all elements are unique, False otherwise
    """
    # Convert to set and compare lengths
    return len(lst) == len(set(lst))


# Test cases
assert all_unique([1, 2, 3]) == True
print("Test passed!")

# Additional test cases for clarity:
assert all_unique([]) == True          # Empty list is unique
assert all_unique([1, 1, 2]) == False  # Duplicates exist
